title: Multi-brand Travel Storefront
summary: An Nx monorepo for a fictional travel storefront with two brand themes, three languages and shared libraries.
description:
Built from scratch to show how I worked in a large multi-tenant frontend monorepo.

- A Next.js storefront and Storybook sharing UI, theming, i18n and feature-flag libraries.
- An accessible image lightbox, an expired-session alert dialog and a cart that handles price changes.
- Playwright and Storybook tests in CI.
